property_summary: For any account, a holder of TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE (the stored admin of PROPOSER_ROLE) can grant PROPOSER_ROLE and the account becomes a member; the mutant makes getRoleAdmin return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE which nobody holds, so granting always reverts for some accounts.
change_summary: Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored admin role for the given role.
